description: ALWAYS use this skill when the user asks to schedule, automate, set up recurring tasks, create a cron job, or anything involving timed / periodic execution.  Do NOT use the local system crontab — scheduled tasks are stored on the Unique AI Platform and executed by a Kubernetes CronJob, not locally.  Scheduled tasks always run on the current assistant (`$UNIQUE_ASSISTANT_ID`); never ask the user which assistant to use, neither in chat nor via `unique-cli elicit ask`. This skill covers creating, listing, updating, enabling, disabling, and deleting scheduled tasks via the unique-cli schedule command.
